北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，体感舒适，户外活动很棒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy your outdoor activities!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波体感闷热，湿度高，风力较大，注意补水防暑。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo feels muggy and humid with strong winds. Stay hydrated and cool.
宁波.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感炎热潮湿，外出注意防暑，多喝水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is hot and humid. Stay cool and hydrated!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨蒙蒙，湿度大，记得带伞，小心路滑。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气阴沉潮湿，体感微热，注意出行安全。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and humid. Stay safe and take care!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨，风力较大，出门记得带伞，注意防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has moderate rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella and stay warm.
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降10℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阵雨伴大风，体感凉，注意添衣保暖，携带雨具。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has showers and strong winds. Dress warmly and bring an umbrella!
南京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感炎热，紫外线强，注意防晒补水哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels hot and sunny. Remember sun protection and hydration!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感微热，风力较大，出门注意防风防晒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is warm with strong winds. Mind the wind and sun.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗炎热，紫外线强，记得防晒，多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot. Protect yourself from the sun and drink water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感酷热，风力不小，注意防暑降温和补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is extremely hot with strong winds. Stay cool and hydrated!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感凉爽，湿度稍高，小心着凉哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cool and a bit humid. Don't catch a cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阳光正好，体感舒适，风力稍大，注意防风。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and pleasant, but windy. Mind the wind!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感舒适，风力较大，外出注意防风。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels pleasant, but it's windy. Be mindful of the wind!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天潮湿，风力较大，体感微热，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, humid, and windy. Stay comfortable and safe.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力很大哦，体感舒适，出门注意防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very windy and pleasant. Mind the strong winds!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感舒适，风力较大，注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and pleasant but windy. Watch out for the wind!
大连.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阵雨伴大风，体感凉爽，出门务必携带雨具。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has showers and strong winds. Bring your umbrella and dress smart.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感偏热，湿度较高，记得多补水哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels hot and humid. Remember to hydrate!
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃
